datasets.name: Bijie Landslide Dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie Landslide Dataset can be found here: [http://gpcv.whu.edu.cn/data/Bijie_pages.html].

datasets.name: Shuicheng landslide inventory data
datasets.verbatim: Shuicheng landslide inventory data from 2019 was obtained from the Shuicheng County government (http://www.shuicheng.gov.cn/ (accessed on 30 June 2020)).

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 images
datasets.verbatim: As for the processing of remote sensing images, we obtained Sentinel-2 images from the European Space Agency (https://scihub.copernicus.eu/dhus/ (accessed on 4 August 2021)).

methods.name: FCN-FLK (Fully Convolutional Network with Focal Loss and K-fold cross-validation)
methods.summary: An improved fully convolutional network (FCN) that incorporates a symmetric connection structure to increase feature levels, uses a focal loss function to address sample imbalance by reducing the contribution of easy-to-classify background pixels, and is trained using 5-fold cross-validation to improve robustness and data utilization.

availability.author_statement: Partial dataset mention in the Data Availability statement.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced and accessible, but the custom FCN-FLK method code is not provided or linked.
